name: context-passport
description: Context Passport V3: self-improving, privacy-first browser memory for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini

scripts.test:v3: npm run --prefix v3 typecheck && npm run --prefix v3 test && PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/test_v3_lifecycle.py backend/tests/test_step4_ingest_privacy_preferences.py backend/tests/test_step7_vault_lifecycle.py backend/tests/test_step8_local_runtime_reliability.py backend/tests/test_step10_routing_benchmarking.py -q
scripts.test:integration: APP_ENV=test ALLOW_TEST_AUTH=true RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true ALLOW_OFFLINE_EMBEDDINGS=false USE_MOCK_EXTRACTOR=false USE_MOCK_EMBEDDER=false LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openrouter ENABLE_JEV_VALIDATION=true PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/test_v1_working_brain.py -m integration
